ayahs.textArabic: صۤ ۗوَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِى الذِّكْرِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṣād, wal-qur'āni żiż-żikr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Sad. CONSIDER this Qur’an, endowed with all that one ought to remember!

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِيْ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Balil-lażīna kafarū fī ‘izzatiw wa syiqāq(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: But nay - they who are bent on denying the truth are lost in [false] pride, and [hence] deeply in the wrong.

ayahs.textArabic: كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَّلَاتَ حِيْنَ مَنَاصٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw wa lāta ḥīna manāṣ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: How many a generation have We destroyed before their time [for this very sin]! And [how] they called [unto Us] when it was too late to escape!

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَجِبُوْٓا اَنْ جَاۤءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖوَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ‘ajibū an jā'ahum munżirum minhum, wa qālal-kāfirūna hāżā sāḥirun każżāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now these [people] deem it strange that a warner should have come unto them from their own midst - and [so] the deniers of the truth are saying: “A [mere] spellbinder is he, a liar!

ayahs.textArabic: اَجَعَلَ الْاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًا ۖاِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Aja‘alal-ālihata ilāhaw wāḥidā(n), inna hāżā lasyai'un ‘ujāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Does he claim that all the deities are [but] one God? Verily, a most strange thing is this!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْهُمْ اَنِ امْشُوْا وَاصْبِرُوْا عَلٰٓى اٰلِهَتِكُمْ ۖاِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُّرَادُ ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wanṭalaqal-mala'u minhum animsyū waṣbirū ‘alā ālihatikum, inna hāżā lasyai'uy yurād(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And their leaders launch forth [thus]: “Go ahead, and hold steadfastly onto your deities: this, behold, is the only thing to do!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِى الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةِ ۖاِنْ هٰذَآ اِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā sami‘nā bihāżā fil-millatil-ākhirah(ti), in hāżā illakhtilāq(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Never did we hear of [a claim like] this in any faith of latter days! It is nothing but [a mortal man’s] invention!

ayahs.textArabic: اَؤُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۗبَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْ ذِكْرِيْۚ بَلْ لَّمَّا يَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: A'unzila ‘alaihiż-żikru mim baininā, bal hum fī syakkim min żikrī, bal lammā yażūqū ‘ażāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: What! Upon him alone from among all of us should a [divine] reminder have been bestowed from on high?” Nay, but it is My Own reminder that they distrust! Nay, they have not yet tasted the suffering which I do impose!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَاۤىِٕنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيْزِ الْوَهَّابِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ‘indahum khazā'inu raḥmati rabbikal-‘azīzil-wahhāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or do they [think that they] own the treasures of thy Sustainer’s grace - [the grace] of the Almighty, the Giver of Gifts?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ لَهُمْ مُّلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۗفَلْيَرْتَقُوْا فِى الْاَسْبَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Am lahum mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā, falyartaqū fil-asbāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or [that] the dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? Why, then, let them try to ascend [to God-like power] by all [conceivable] means!

ayahs.textArabic: جُنْدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُوْمٌ مِّنَ الْاَحْزَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Jundum mā hunālika mahzūmum minal-aḥzāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] there it is: any and all human beings, however [strongly] leagued together, are bound to suffer defeat [whenever they refuse to accept the truth].

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْاَوْتَادِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabat qablahum qaumu nūḥiw wa ‘āduw wa fir‘aunu żul-autād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: To the truth gave the lie aforetime Noah’s people, and [the tribe of] Ad, and Pharaoh of the [many] tent-poles,

ayahs.textArabic: وَثَمُوْدُ وَقَوْمُ لُوْطٍ وَّاَصْحٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الْاَحْزَابُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ṡamūdu wa qaumu lūṭiw wa aṣḥābul-aikah(ti), ulā'ikal-aḥzāb(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [the tribe of] Thamud, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the wooded dales [of Madyan]: they all were leagued together, [as it were, in their unbelief:]

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: In kullun illā każżabar-rusula faḥaqqa ‘iqāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: not one [was there] but gave the lie to the apostles - and thereupon My retribution fell due.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā yanẓuru hā'ulā'i illā ṣaiḥataw wāḥidatam mā lahā min fawāq(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they [who now deny the truth - they, too,] have but to wait for one single blast [of punishment to overtake them]: it shall not be delayed a whit.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū rabbanā ‘ajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yaumil-ḥisāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: As it is, they say [mockingly]: “O our Sus­tainer! Hasten on to us our share [of punishment even] before the Day of Reckoning!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الْاَيْدِۚ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Iṣbir ‘alā mā yaqūlūna ważkur ‘abdanā dāwūda żal-aid(i), innahū awwāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] bear thou with patience whatever they may say, and remember Our servant David, him who was endowed with [so much] inner strength! He, verily, would always turn unto Us:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْاِشْرَاقِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā sakhkharnal-jibāla ma‘ahū yusabbiḥna bil-‘asyiyyi wal-isyrāq(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and for this,] behold, We caused the mountains to join him in extolling Our limitless glory at eventide and at sun­rise,

ayahs.textArabic: وَالطَّيْرَمَحْشُوْرَةً ۗ كُلٌّ لَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Waṭ-ṭaira maḥsyūrah(tan), kullul lahū awwāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [likewise] the birds in their assemblies: [together] they all Would turn again and again unto Him [who had created them].

ayahs.textArabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهٗ وَاٰتَيْنٰهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa syadadnā mulkahū wa ātaināhul-ḥikmata wa faṣlal-khiṭāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We streng­thened his dominion, and bestowed upon him wisdom and sagacity in judgment.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَهَلْ اَتٰىكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِۘ اِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa hal atāka naba'ul-khaṣm(i), iż tasawwarul-miḥrāb(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND YET, has the story of the litigants come within thy ken - [the story of the two] who surmounted the walls of the sanctuary [in which David prayed]?

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلٰى دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْۚ خَصْمٰنِ بَغٰى بَعْضُنَا عَلٰى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَآ اِلٰى سَوَاۤءِ الصِّرَاطِ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż dakhalū ‘alā dāwūda fafazi‘a minhum qālū lā takhaf, khaṣmāni bagā ba‘ḍunā ‘alā ba‘ḍin faḥkum bainanā bil-ḥaqqi wa lā tusyṭiṭ wahdinā ilā sawā'iṣ-ṣirāṭ(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: As they came upon David, and he shrank back in fear from them, they said: “Fear not! [We are but] two litigants. One of us has wronged the other: so judge thou between us with justice, and deviate not from what is right, and show [both of] us the way to rectitude.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذَآ اَخِيْ ۗ لَهٗ تِسْعٌ وَّتِسْعُوْنَ نَعْجَةً وَّلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ ۗفَقَالَ اَكْفِلْنِيْهَا وَعَزَّنِيْ فِى الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżā akhī, lahū tis‘uw wa tis‘ūna na‘jataw wa liya na‘jatuw wāḥidah(tun), faqāla aqfilnīhā wa ‘azzanī fil-khiṭāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Behold, this is my brother: he has ninety-nine ewes, whereas I have [only] one ewe - and yet he said, ‘Make her over to me,’ and forcibly prevailed against me in this [our] dispute.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ اِلٰى نِعَاجِهٖۗ وَاِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَاۤءِ لَيَبْغِيْ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيْلٌ مَّا هُمْۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَ ۩
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisu'āli na‘jatika ilā ni‘ājih(ī), wa inna kaṡīram minal-khulaṭā'i layabgī ba‘ḍuhum ‘alā ba‘ḍin illal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa qalīlum mā hum, wa ẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fastagfara rabbahū wa kharra rāki‘aw wa anāb(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [David]: “He has certainly wronged thee by demanding that thy ewe be added to his ewes! Thus, behold, do many kinsmen wrong one another [all] save those who believe [in God] and do righteous deeds: but how few are they!” And [suddenly] David understood that We had tried him: and so he asked his Sustainer to forgive him his sin, and fell down in prostration, and turned unto Him in repentance.

ayahs.textArabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَۗ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰى وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa gafarnā lahū żālik(a), wa inna lahū ‘indanā lazulfā wa ḥusna ma'āb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thereupon We forgave him that [sin]: and, verily, nearness to Us awaits him [in the life to come], and the most beauteous of all goals!

ayahs.textArabic: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰكَ خَلِيْفَةً فِى الْاَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوٰى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَضِلُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ ۢبِمَا نَسُوْا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā dāwūdu innā ja‘alnāka khalīfatan fil-arḍi faḥkum bainan nāsi bil-ḥaqqi wa lā tattabi‘il-hawā fa yuḍillaka ‘an sabīlillāh(i), innal-lażīna yaḍillūna ‘an sabīlillāhi lahum ‘ażābun syadīdum bimā nasū yaumal-ḥisāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And We said:] “O David! Behold, We have made thee a [prophet and, thus, Our] vicegerent on earth: judge, then, between men with justice, and do not follow vain desire, lest it lead thee astray from the path of God: verily, for those who go astray from the path of God there is suffering severe in store for having forgotten the Day of Reckoning!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاۤءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۗذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنَ النَّارِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā khalaqnas-samā'a wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā bāṭilā(n), żālika ẓannul-lażīna kafarū, fawailul lil-lażīna kafarū minan-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [thus it is:] We have not created heaven and earth and all that is between them without meaning and purpose, as is the surmise of those who are bent on denying the truth: but then, woe from the fire [of hell] unto all who are bent on denying the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِۖ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Am naj‘alul-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti kal-mufsidīna fil-arḍ(i), am naj‘alul-muttaqīna kal-fujjār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [For,] would We treat those who have attained to faith and do righteous deeds in the same manner as [We shall treat] those who spread corruption on earth? Would We treat the God-conscious in the same manner as the wicked?

ayahs.textArabic: كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اِلَيْكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوْٓا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Kitābun anzalnāhu ilaika mubārakul liyaddabbarū āyātihī wa liyatażakkara ulul-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [All this have We expounded in this] blessed divine writ which We have revealed unto thee, [O Muhammad,] so that men may ponder over its mes­sages, and that those who are endowed with insight may take them to heart.

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيْمٰنَۗ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۗاِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wahabnā lidāwūda wa sulaimān(a), ni‘mal-‘abd(u), innahū awwāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND UNTO DAVID We granted Solomon [as a son - and] how excellent a servant [of Ours he grew up to be]! Behold, he would always turn unto Us -

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الْجِيَادُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż ‘uriḍa ‘alaihi bil-‘asyiyyiṣ-ṣāfinātul-jiyād(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and even] when, towards the close of day, nobly-bred, swift-footed steeds were brought before him,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالَ اِنِّيْٓ اَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّيْۚ حَتّٰى تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa qāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubbal-khairi ‘an żikri rabbī, ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: he would say, “Verily, I have come to love the love of all that is good because I bear my Sustainer in mind!” [repeating these words as the steeds raced away,] until they were hidden by the veil [of distance - whereupon he would command],

ayahs.textArabic: رُدُّوْهَا عَلَيَّ ۚفَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا ۢبِالسُّوْقِ وَالْاَعْنَاقِ
ayahs.textLatin: Ruddūhā ‘alayy(a), faṭafiqa masḥam bis-sūqi wal-a‘nāq(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Bring them back unto me!”- and would [lovingly] stroke their legs and their necks.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَلْقَيْنَا عَلٰى كُرْسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad fatannā sulaimāna wa alqainā ‘alā kursiyyihī jasadan ṡumma anāb(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [ere this], indeed, We had tried Solomon by placing upon his throne a [lifeless] body; and thereupon he turned [towards Us; and]

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَهَبْ لِيْ مُلْكًا لَّا يَنْۢبَغِيْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِيْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbigfir lī wa hab lī mulkal lā yambagī li'aḥadim mim ba‘dī, innaka antal-wahhāb(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: he prayed: “O my Sustainer! Forgive me my sins, and bestow upon me the gift of a kingdom which may not suit anyone after me: verily, Thou alone art a giver of gifts!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيْحَ تَجْرِيْ بِاَمْرِهٖ رُخَاۤءً حَيْثُ اَصَابَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fasakhkharnā lahur-rīḥa tajrī bi'amrihī rukhā'an ḥaiṡu aṣāb(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We made subservient to him the wind, so that it gently sped at his behest whithersoever he willed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَالشَّيٰطِيْنَ كُلَّ بَنَّاۤءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wasy-syayāṭīna kulla bannā'iw wa gawwāṣ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: as well as all the rebellious forces [that We made to work for him] - every kind of builder and diver -

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاٰخَرِيْنَ مُقَرَّنِيْنَ فِى الْاَصْفَادِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ākharīna muqarranīna fil-aṣfād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and others linked together in fetters.

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا عَطَاۤؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ اَوْ اَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā ‘aṭā'unā famnun au amsik bigairi ḥisāb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And We told him:] “This is Our gift, for thee to bestow freely on others, or to withhold, without [having to render] account!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰى وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna lahū ‘indanā lazulfā wa ḥusna ma'āb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, verily, nearness to Us awaits him [in the life to come], and the most beauteous of all goals!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ اَيُّوْبَۘ اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗٓ اَنِّيْ مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَّعَذَابٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur ‘abdanā ayyūb(a), iż nādā rabbahū annī massaniyasy-syaiṭānu binuṣbiw wa ‘ażāb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind Our servant Job, [how it was] when he cried out to his Sustainer, “Behold, Satan has afflicted me with [utter] weariness and suffering!”

ayahs.textArabic: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَۚ هٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Urkuḍ birijlik(a), hāżā mugtasalum bāriduw wa syarāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and thereupon was told:] “Strike [the ground] with thy foot: here is cool water to wash with and to drink!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗٓ اَهْلَهٗ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرٰى لِاُولِى الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wahabnā lahū ahlahū wa miṡlahum ma‘ahum raḥmatam minnā wa żikrā li'ulil-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We bestowed upon him new offspring, doubling their number as an act of grace from Us, and as a reminder unto all who are endowed with insight.

ayahs.textArabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗاِنَّا وَجَدْنٰهُ صَابِرًا ۗنِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۗاِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa khuż biyadika ḍigṡan faḍrib bihī wa lā taḥnaṡ, innā wajadnāhu ṣābirā(n), ni‘mal-‘abd(u), innahū awwāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And finally We told him:] “Now take in thy hand a small bunch of grass, and strike therewith, and thou wilt not break thine oath!” for, verily, We found him full of patience in adversity: how excellent a servant [of Ours], who, behold, would always turn unto Us!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ عِبٰدَنَآ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ اُولِى الْاَيْدِيْ وَالْاَبْصَارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur ‘ibādanā ibrāhīma wa isḥāqa wa ya‘qūba ulil-aidī wal-abṣār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind Our servants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, [all of them] endowed with inner strength and vision:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَخْلَصْنٰهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin żikrad-dār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, verily, We purified them by means of a thought most pure: the remembrance of the life to come.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْاَخْيَارِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahum ‘indanā laminal-muṣṭafainal-akhyār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, behold, in Our sight they were indeed among the elect, the truly good!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۗوَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْاَخْيَارِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur ismā‘īla wal-yasa‘a wa żal-kifl(i), wa kullum minal-akhyār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And call to mind Ishmael and Elisha, and every one who [like them] has pledged himself [unto Us]: for, each of them was of the truly good!

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۗوَاِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ لَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā żikr(un), wa inna lil-muttaqīna laḥusna ma'āb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: LET [all] this be a reminder [to those who believe in God] - for, verily, the most beauteous of all goals awaits the God-conscious:

ayahs.textArabic: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْاَبْوَابُۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Jannāti ‘adnim mufattaḥatal lahumul-abwāb(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: gardens of perpetual bliss, with gates wide-open to them,

ayahs.textArabic: مُتَّكِـِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيْرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Muttaki'īna fīhā yad‘ūna fīhā bifākihatin kaṡīratiw wa syarāb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: wherein they will recline, [and] wherein they may [freely] call for many a fruit and drink,

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَعِنْدَهُمْ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرْفِ اَتْرَابٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ‘indahum qāṣirātuṭ-ṭarfi atrāb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: having beside them well-matched mates of modest gaze.”

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā mā tū‘adūna liyaumil-ḥisāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنْ نَّفَادٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ina hāżā larizqunā mā lahū min nafād(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: this, verily, shall be Our provision [for you], with no end to it!

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا ۗوَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيْنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā, wa inna liṭ-ṭāgīna lasyarra ma'āb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: All this [for the righteous]: but, verily, the most evil of all goals awaits those who are wont to transgress the bounds of what is right:

ayahs.textArabic: جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصْلَوْنَهَاۚ فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
ayahs.textLatin: Jahannam(a), yaṣlaunahā, fabi'sal-mihād(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: hell will they have to endure - and how vile a resting-place!

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَاۙ فَلْيَذُوْقُوْهُ حَمِيْمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā, falyażūqūhu ḥamīmuw wa gassāq(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: This, [then, for them -] so let them taste it: burning despair and ice-cold darkness

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ākharu min syaklihī azwāj(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, coupled with it, further [suffering] of a similar nature.

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْۚ  لَا مَرْحَبًا ۢبِهِمْ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا النَّارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā faujum muqtaḥimum ma‘akum, lā marḥabam bihim, innahum ṣālun-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And they will say to one another: “Do you see] this crowd of people who rushed headlong [into sin] with you? No welcome to them! Verily, they [too] shall have to endure the fire!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا بَلْ اَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًاۢ بِكُمْ ۗ اَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوْهُ لَنَاۚ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū bal antum lā marḥabam bikum, antum qaddamtumūhu lanā, fabi'sal-qarār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] they [who had been seduced] will exclaim: “Nay, but it is you! No welcome to you! It is you who have prepared this for us: and how vile a state to abide in!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى النَّارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hāżā fazidhu ‘ażāban ḍi‘fan fin-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] they will pray: “O our Sustainer! Who­ever has prepared this for us, double Thou his suffering in the fire!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰى رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَشْرَارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā na‘udduhum minal-asyrār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will add: “How is it that we do not see [here any of the] men whom we were wont to count among the wicked,

ayahs.textArabic: اَتَّخَذْنٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْاَبْصَارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Attakhażnāhum sikhriyyan am zāgat ‘anhumul-abṣār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] whom we made the target of our derision? Or is it that [they are here, and] our eyes have missed them?”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهْلِ النَّارِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna żālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahlin-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Such, behold, will in truth be the [confusion and] mutual wrangling of the people of the fire!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ مُنْذِرٌ ۖوَّمَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innamā ana munżir(un), wa mā min ilāhin illallāhul-wāḥidul-qahhār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY [O Muhammad]: “I am only a warner; and there is no deity whatever save God, the One, who holds absolute sway over all that exists,

ayahs.textArabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumal-‘azīzul-gaffār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the All-Forgiving!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيْمٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul huwa naba'un ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “This is a message tremendous:

ayahs.textArabic: اَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Antum ‘anhu mu‘riḍūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [how can] you turn away from it?”

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰٓى اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā kāna liya min ‘ilmim bil-mala'il-a‘lā iż yakhtaṣimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Say, O Muhammad:] “No knowledge would I have had of [what passed among] the host on high when they argued [against the creation of man],

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ يُّوْحٰىٓ اِلَيَّ اِلَّآ اَنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Iy yūḥā ilayya illā annamā ana nażīrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: had it not been revealed unto me [by God] - to no other end than that I might convey [unto you] a plain warning.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ اِنِّيْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ طِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla rabbuka lil-malā'ikati innī khāliqum basyaram min ṭīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [For,] lo, thy Sustainer said unto the angels: “Behold, I am about to create a human being out of clay;

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِيْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'iżā sawwaituhū wa nafakhtu fīhi mir rūḥī faqa‘ū lahū sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and when I have formed him fully and breathed into him of My spirit, fall you down before him in prostration!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fasajadal-malā'ikatu kulluhum ajma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together,

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّآ اِبْلِيْسَۗ اِسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā iblīs(a), istakbara wa kāna minal-kafirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: save Iblis: he gloried in his arrogance, and [thus] became one of those who deny the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰٓاِبْلِيْسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۗ اَسْتَكْبَرْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā iblīsu mā mana‘aka an tasjuda  limā khalaqtu biyadayy(a), astakbarta am kunta minal-‘ālīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: “O Iblis! What has kept thee from prostrating thyself before that [being] which I have created with My hands? Art thou too proud [to bow down before another created being], or art thou of those who think [only] of themselves as high?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِيْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ طِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla ana khairum minhu khalaqtanī min nāriw wa khalaqtahū min ṭīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered [Iblis]: “I am better than he: Thou hast created me out of fire, whereas him Thou hast created out of clay.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fakhruj minhā fa'innaka rajīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: “Go forth, then, from this [angelic state] - for, behold, thou art henceforth accursed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِيْٓ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna ‘alaika la‘natī ilā yaumid-dīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and My rejection shall be thy due until the Day of Judgment!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi fa'anẓirnī ilā yaumi yub‘aṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Iblis]: “Then, O my Sustainer, grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fa'innaka minal-munẓarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered He: “Verily, so [be it:] thou shalt be among those who are granted respite

ayahs.textArabic: اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Ilā yaumil-waqtil-ma‘lūm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: till the Day the time whereof is known [only to Me].”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fabi‘izzatika la'ugwiyannahum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Whereupon Iblis] said: “Then [I swear] by Thy very might: I shall most certainly beguile them all into grievous error –

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā ‘ibādaka minhumul-mukhlaṣīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [all] save such of them as are truly Thy servants!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّۖ وَالْحَقَّ اَقُوْلُۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fal-ḥaqq(u), wal-ḥaqqa aqūl(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God] said: “This, then, is the truth! And this truth do I state:

ayahs.textArabic: لَاَمْلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: La'amla'anna jahannama minka wa mimman tabi‘aka minhum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Most certainly will I fill hell with thee and such of them as shall follow thee, all together!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ وَّمَآ اَنَا۠ مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajriw wa mā ana minal-mutakallifīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY [O Prophet]: “No reward whatever do I ask of you for this [message]; and I am not one of those who claim to be what they are not.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: In huwa illā żikrul lil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: This [divine writ], behold, is no less than a reminder to all the worlds —

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعْدَ حِيْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lata‘lamunna naba'ahū ba‘da ḥīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and you will most certainly grasp its purport after a lapse of time!”
